scope: Native i386 application first-entry tracing runtime; no Wine or original/reference execution.
checks: First-entry order uses global and static ELF names, repeated entries suppressed
Accepted application prefix produces no entries
Zero-new-entry case emits an empty trace
i386 fastcall arguments/results and errno survive hooks
PIE/ASLR and ET_EXEC resolve to the same names
Unset RECON_TRACE_FD succeeds with missing configuration and stripped symbols
Missing filter, unknown prefix, read-only descriptor and stripped symbols fail explicitly before application output
timing_note: check_seconds sums the timed individual check runs, including each native launch and local trace-file setup/comparison. Building and strip preparation are outside these sums; their wall times were not separately measured. These are not total development times.
limits: Single-thread ordinary native fixtures. CRT/import/shim entries excluded; canonical Win32 ABI checks remain separate.
